messages.subject: Time recording — April WIP not yet posted
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our records show unposted time on two matters for the second half of April. Please ensure all April time is recorded and released by close on Monday so we can run the month-end WIP report and the client bills.

Thank you,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
